description: Detect and redact private keys, API tokens, JWTs, emails, IBANs, SSNs, phones, IPs, and Luhn-validated payment cards before LLM logging or sharing ($0.001). $0.001 per call over x402 (USDC on Arc, Base or Solana, or XNT on X1). Call once without `payment` for the terms, sign them with your own wallet, call again with `payment`.

payment.description: a signed x402 payment (the base64 payload you would put in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE). Pass it and the purchase completes inside this tool call.
